`xlsx-0.20.3.tgz` is the patched SheetJS Community Edition package distributed by
the publisher at https://cdn.sheetjs.com/xlsx-0.20.3/xlsx-0.20.3.tgz. Its source and
SHA-512 integrity are recorded in `xlsx-source.json`; the archive includes its
license. It is referenced as a local file so npm and pnpm builds are reproducible
even when the publisher's CDN is unavailable.

The publisher documents this installation method and the outdated npm release:
https://docs.sheetjs.com/docs/getting-started/installation/nodejs/.
